title: AICrawl extract request
description: Body for POST /api/v1/extract and the request accepted by `aicrawl extract`.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to fetch. Subject to SSRF, domain and robots.txt policy.

query.description: Natural-language description of the data to extract.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema the extracted payload must validate against.

use_ai.description: Use the configured external AI provider when semantic extraction is needed. Deterministic extraction remains available without it.

render.description: Render JavaScript through the optional Playwright bridge.
